plugins.name: grasp
plugins.description: Deal-work workflows powered by Grasp company lookup, table creation, import, buyer, transaction, table enrichment, contact, and market research tools.

skills.name: company-lookup
skills.description: Use when the current task is to resolve, validate, or analyze one specific company in Grasp: understanding a named target, buyer, reference, or sample company before a list, buyer, transaction, contact, or table workflow; fetching business, financial, ownership, employee, LinkedIn, deal, or similar-company profile sections; resolving ambiguous names/domains/org numbers; or checking whether a company exists in Grasp or may be missing from a table.
skills.description_zh: 在 Grasp 中识别、验证或分析单个公司，获取业务、财务、所有权、员工、LinkedIn、交易与相似公司档案，消歧名称/域名/组织编号，并检查公司是否存在或从表中缺失，供后续名单、买方、交易和联系人流程使用。

skills.name: creating-tables
skills.description: Use when the user wants to find, build, generate, source, map, or import a long list/source universe of companies, targets, peers, competitors, buyers, acquirers, investors, or M&A/deal transactions. Creates or imports the initial Grasp table, then waits, inspects, and hands off to screening-and-shortlisting, table enrichment, table work, or contacts as needed.
skills.description_zh: 在 Grasp 创建或导入企业、目标、同行、竞争者、买方、收购方、投资者或并购交易的长名单初始表，等待检查后按需交给筛选、补全、表格操作或联系人流程。

skills.name: finding-contacts
skills.description: Use when the user explicitly asks for person-level outreach contacts for a selected set of Grasp companies or buyers: work emails, phone numbers, person LinkedIn profiles, CEO/CFO/founder/owner contact details, corporate development or M&A people, decision-makers, or outreach lists.
skills.description_zh: 为选定的 Grasp 企业或买方查找明确人员级联系资料，包括工作邮箱、电话、LinkedIn、CEO/CFO/创始人/所有者和企业发展或并购决策者，用于外联名单。

skills.name: screening-and-shortlisting
skills.description: Screens and shortlists Grasp tables/universes into qualified, prioritized, ranked, or top-N outputs across companies, buyers, targets, peers, competitors, acquirers, investors, or deals. Use when the user asks to screen, narrow, qualify, shortlist, prioritize, rank, select best/top candidates, map a landscape, or produce recommendations from a Grasp long list. Enforces coverage checks, enrichment/research/proxies, table links, and transparent escalation.
skills.description_zh: 将 Grasp 长名单筛选为合格、优先、排序或前N候选，覆盖企业、买方、目标和交易；落实覆盖检查、补全/研究/代理指标、表链接和透明升级。

skills.name: table-enrichment
skills.description: Use when the user wants to add, populate, enrich, fill, estimate, compute, classify, segment, or evaluate data on an existing Grasp table: financials, employees/headcount, current ownership, locations, LinkedIn data, buyer metadata, deal values, transaction details, research columns, computed fields, company-level phone/email/website fields, or fit notes.
skills.description_zh: 为已有 Grasp 表补全、估计、计算、分类或评估财务、人数、所有权、位置、LinkedIn、买方元数据、交易价值、研究列、企业联系字段和匹配备注。

skills.name: working-with-tables
skills.description: Use when the user wants to inspect, search, filter, keep/remove/exclude rows, sort, query, describe coverage, read rows, export, or recover handles for an existing Grasp table.
skills.description_zh: 查看、搜索、过滤、保留/删除/排除行、排序、查询、导出已有 Grasp 表，说明覆盖度并恢复表句柄。
